    Profile

    Sophia is an elf from Lustburg with the ability to control snow. She's a gentle, unsophisticated person who sleeps more than most people. In battle however, she's very swift, and she fights gallantly using various kinds of magic. She usually lives in her family's village, but she sometimes enjoys sneaking into human settlements.

    Origin: Lustburg
    Gender: Female
    Height: 167cm
    Weight: 55kg
    Birthday: Sep 30
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Ice Water Wolf
    Likes: Sleeping, eating
    Hobbies: Sneaking around cities
    Illust: 芳住和之
    CV: 斉藤佑圭
